item.title: Governor Braun Launches Pilot Program Allowing State Employees to Bring Infants to Work
item.description: Indiana Governor Mike Braun has announced the launch of the Family First Workplace initiative, a new pilot program that will allow eligible state employees to bring their infants to work during the first six months of life.
